description: This file is a build script written in JavaScript that orchestrates build steps for a project, such as cleaning up symlinks and invoking a build command via pnpm. It includes functions to remove stale symlinks, handle process execution, and interpret build results.

methods.name: removeDistPluginNodeModulesSymlinks
methods.description: Removes symbolic links to node_modules inside the 'extensions' directory of a given root directory.

methods.name: pruneStaleRuntimeSymlinks
methods.description: Removes specific stale symlinks related to runtime overlays in 'dist' and 'dist-runtime' directories.

methods.name: findFatalUnresolvedImport
methods.description: Analyzes build output lines to identify unresolved import errors that are outside expected directories.
